verification.native_file_reference: Actual pinned native file subscribers serialize the same two original lifecycle spans to JSON lines and length-delimited protobuf. Parsed JSON values match including default fields and hex identifiers; binary frames match byte for byte.
verification.headers: 26 actual native trace-exporter construction outcomes match the qualified header/endpoint boundary. Configuration-only validation outcomes are preserved separately because some checks occur at construction.
verification.file_lifecycle: Actual files cover shared handle reuse through directory aliases, conflicting mode/format refusal, append/overwrite, empty batches, private modes, confinement, symlink/directory/FIFO refusal, closed destinations and explicit flush/fsync.
verification.actual_plugin: An enabled file-only plugin receives original qualified scope/mark/end events and writes independently decoded JSON/protobuf records, preserving root identity and marks; validation performs no output I/O.

limits: Full span attribute projection, native batching and metadata-resource routing remain separate contracts; verifying this file backend does not claim every NeMo Relay public API.
The configured existing directory is a trusted filesystem anchor and can contain system aliases. Newly created descendants and output files use handle-relative no-follow opens.
The Windows implementation preserves native handle-relative NtCreateFile and protected owner/SYSTEM DACL policy. Portable ABI/layout tests are not evidence of actual Windows host conformance.
Runtime file-backed header reads are bounded to 64 KiB; larger sources refuse explicitly. No native executable or extension is embedded.
